channel.title: Indecs for Mac
channel.description: Updates for Indecs for Mac. Items are added by build.sh --dist --publish in the indecs-macos repo, newest first.

item.title: Indecs 1.0.27
item.description:
• New app icon matching indecs.app.

  • Consistent folder, document and account layouts with native Mac controls.

  • Taller Settings window with scrolling for all options.

  • Upload and processing dialogs stay attached to the window that opened them.

  • Reconnect without losing watched folders or queued files.

  • Saved error history in Documents, including errors from earlier sessions.

  • First release: watch folders, drop files anywhere (menu bar, Dock, drop zone, main window), see your documents, stats and credits.

  • Connect to indecs.app from the app; the key stays in this Mac’s keychain.

  • Files are labelled in place: title, Finder tags and a summary comment.

  • Settings and watched folders can sync between Macs through iCloud when a provisioning profile is installed.

  • Stack copies within a configurable window into one pasteboard set.

  • Clips panel: browse, copy and preview recent files copied from your folders.
